This '''[[Jedi chapter house/Legends|Jedi chapter house]]''' was located on [[Aleen Minor/Legends|Aleen Minor]]. During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], after the [[Battle of Antar 4 (Separatist Crisis)|mission]] to [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] led by [[Sarrissa Jeng/Legends|Sarrissa Jeng]] brought fellow Jedi [[Antyard-Wo Shissan]] and [[Kaloor Cofi]] to Aleen after they were slain in battle.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]], the Aleen Minor chapter house was mistakenly placed on [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]], a planet in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that was created to resolve continuity issues introduced by the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' series.
